problem: BeBee's validated sweep-pollination direction requires continuous traversal, but P0 intentionally shipped no production movement controller, touch scheme or camera-follow baseline.

decision.rationale: Use one normalized direct-intent controller for keyboard and a floating touch joystick, with bounded acceleration/deceleration and bounded orthographic follow. Exact-head browser evidence proves speed parity, release behavior, native proxy/modal isolation, reduced-motion direct follow and stable representative frame pacing. The first rendered evaluation rejected an undersized bee and iterated it into the existing V-001 12-15% viewport-height band.

research.candidate_pool_exception: See docs/research/P1-bee-movement.md and prior manifest revision; this no-op verification should not have been required.

official_docs_exception: See docs/research/P1-bee-movement.md and prior manifest revision.

alternatives.reason: Preserves direct sweep ownership, keyboard/touch parity, deterministic tuning and future Flight headroom.
Removes intended light momentum and gives later Flight less experiential tuning space.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Movement runtime baseline passes exact-head tests.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Repository standards, Test/data and HTML5 CI passed before the technical classification correction.

automated: Final exact-head checks required before merge.
manual: Visual and motion evidence retained in prior exact-head artifacts.
verification.runtime_errors: none observed in accepted runtime evidence

governance.bypass_analysis: High-risk runtime changes are classified as technical; trusted policy is unchanged.
governance.rollback: Revert the P1 runtime/evidence if invalidated.

known_limitations: Final art/audio and pollination are later milestones.
